# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest (Grinder Harness)

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to run the Stage-1 backtest using the grinder harness on full 16-month OPRA data to compute edge_capture and wide_pnl for the current engine baseline, then perform walk-forward OOS test and real-fills validation on the top 3 J-days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04).

## Mechanism

The grinder harness will iterate over all parameter combos (if any) or run the baseline configuration, compute P&L per trade, aggregate to edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers)), and wide_pnl (total P&L). Then we will run a walk-forward OOS test (e.g., train on first 12 months, test on last 4 months) and compute OOS edge_capture and Sharpe. Finally, we will validate real-fills on the top 3 J-days by comparing BS-sim vs realistic OPRA fills.
